skill.name: nerdzao-elite-gemini-high
skill.description: A prompt-only workflow for senior coding, TDD, clean code, production review, and detailed UI/UX validation.
skill.summary: Guide coding tasks through planning, architecture, testing, clean implementation, and visual quality checks.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. I found no semantic evidence of executable behavior, data exfiltration, audit bypass instructions, or malicious prompt injection intent.

content.user_title: Improve Coding and UI Review Quality
content.value_statement: Complex coding tasks often miss planning, testing, and visual polish. This skill guides work through architecture, TDD, clean code, and UI validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides tasks through planning, architecture, implementation, validation, and final verification.
Promotes TDD, clean code refactoring, linting, and production review habits.
Adds focused UI checks for spacing, labels, colors, hierarchy, and responsiveness.
Encourages concise final responses with code and brief visual change notes.
Frames coding work from both senior engineering and product design perspectives.
limitations: It is prompt-only and does not run tests, linters, or visual tools by itself.
It references Gemini 3.1 Pro High but cannot change the active model.
It does not include project-specific rules, design tokens, or repository conventions.
It asks for chain-of-thought, but assistants should provide concise reasoning summaries.

use_cases.title: Polish Frontend Changes
use_cases.description: Check a UI change for layout, spacing, labels, colors, hierarchy, and responsive behavior.

use_cases.title: Structure Feature Work
use_cases.description: Plan a feature with architecture choices, tests, implementation order, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Review Product Quality
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether an implementation matches expected product behavior and visual quality.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Small UI Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for a focused visual update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to inspect my UI change. Check layout, spacing, labels, colors, and responsiveness. Return concise fixes and final notes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the elite workflow to plan this feature. Include architecture choices, tests, risks, and a short implementation order.

prompt_templates.title: Implement and Validate
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the requested change with TDD. Then run relevant validation steps and summarize code and visual fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Production Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a production-grade review of this branch. Cover architecture, tests, security, performance, UI consistency, and release risks.

output_examples.output: Identifies currency formatting issues, spacing problems, and label inconsistencies. Provides concise fixes and a final visual validation summary.

output_examples.input: Plan and implement a new dashboard filter.
output_examples.output: Produces a short plan, test approach, implementation notes, validation checklist, and release risks.

output_examples.input: Review this pull request before release.
output_examples.output: Highlights architecture concerns, missing tests, UI regressions, and concrete actions needed before approval.

best_practices: Provide the current task, relevant files, and expected user behavior before asking for changes.
Run real tests, linting, and visual checks when the repository supports them.
Ask for concise summaries of reasoning instead of hidden chain-of-thought.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on the prompt as a replacement for automated testing.
Do not use it to force a model to reveal private reasoning.
Do not assume referenced helper workflows are installed in every environment.

faq.question: Does this skill execute code?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only workflow and does not include scripts or executable files.

faq.question: Can it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can request tests and validation, but the assistant or user must run available tools.

faq.question: Is it only for Gemini?
faq.answer: It is written for Gemini 3.1 Pro High, but the workflow can guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What tasks fit this skill best?
faq.answer: It fits coding, UI polish, architecture review, TDD implementation, and production readiness checks.

faq.question: Does it replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It supports review habits, but human review remains important for product and business context.

faq.question: How should I handle the chain-of-thought instruction?
faq.answer: Ask for concise reasoning summaries. Do not request hidden private reasoning from the assistant.
